big_case.notes: A state petition on whether 90-day PLRA preliminary injunctions evade review in the Fifth Circuit. Recurring for prison litigation in one circuit, but the vehicle was compromised (state won final judgment May 26, 2026; expired, vacated injunctions) and the Court denied without noted dissent or statement. Modest stakes outside prison-conditions practice.
